agents.name: supervisor
agents.purpose: Route user tasks, split work, and dispatch to specialized agents with structured outputs.

agents.name: code_agent
agents.purpose: Generate code content and optional extra files (for example requirements.txt) in strict JSON format.

agents.name: file_agent
agents.purpose: Perform local file operations: read, write, list, and save generated artifacts to target paths.

agents.name: runner_agent
agents.purpose: Execute generated local scripts and verify expected output artifacts (for example csv/png).

agents.name: weather_agent
agents.purpose: Fetch weather data from reliable weather sources and produce concise weather summaries.

agents.name: news_agent
agents.purpose: Fetch topic-specific news from configured news sources and summarize key items with links.

agents.name: stock_agent
agents.purpose: Fetch stock/market quotes and provide concise trend summaries with source links.

agents.name: web_agent
agents.purpose: Run broad web searches and synthesize concise, source-grounded answers.

agents.name: judge_agent
agents.purpose: Evaluate answer quality, format final response, and trigger web verification when needed.
